challenges.title: An interesting shadow
challenges.description: Find and photograph a shadow you like, wherever you are.

challenges.title: An overlooked detail
challenges.description: Photograph a detail you never usually notice, somewhere familiar.

challenges.title: A close-up texture
challenges.description: Get as close as you can to a surface that intrigues you and capture its texture.

challenges.title: Something red
challenges.description: Go on the hunt for something red and photograph it.

challenges.title: An unexpected reflection
challenges.description: Find an unusual reflective surface (shop window, spoon, puddle) and photograph your reflection.

challenges.title: An unusual angle
challenges.description: Pick an everyday object and photograph it from an angle you never use.

challenges.title: The light right now
challenges.description: Photograph the light exactly as it is right now, indoors or outside.

challenges.title: Intentional blur
challenges.description: Photograph a moving scene, letting the blur happen on purpose.

challenges.title: A repeating pattern
challenges.description: Spot a pattern or repetition (tiles, windows, leaves) and photograph it.

challenges.title: Whatever makes you smile
challenges.description: Photograph the first thing that makes you smile today.
